scope: Static review of the supplied archive plus implemented targeted regressions and limited supplemental execution. Not an assertion that every possible gap was found.

priority.P0: False-green verification or equivalent release-blocking assurance failure.
priority.P1: Data integrity, destructive-operation safety, primary workflows, security boundaries, or broad assurance holes.
priority.P2: Important edge cases, portability, maintainability, observability or design-dependent hardening.
priority.P3: Optional polish (no entries assigned in this audit).

scoring.confidence: 0-100 confidence that the stated gap/opportunity exists in this archive, not probability that an unexecuted patch passes. 100 may reflect directly observed absence of an E2E harness or a deterministic reproduction; lower values indicate policy/input uncertainty.

complexity.1: One narrow test or guard, no new environment.
complexity.2: Small focused suite or helper change.
complexity.3: Multiple modules or joined fixture/transport integration.
complexity.4: Browser/process/platform matrix or substantial harness work.

scoring.sort: Priority first, then higher confidence, then lower complexity, then stable finding ID. IDs remain stable and are not the rank.

status.implemented: Code/test patch exists; canonical execution remains unverified unless explicitly stated.
status.partial: Browser code exists, but dependency/lock setup and first browser execution remain outstanding.
status.pending: Reviewed improvement with detailed implementation specification, not implemented.

findings.title: Coverage gate accepts empty or non-measurable reports
findings.observed_gap: Baseline summarizeLcovReport treats absent measurable lines as 100%; an empty report and arbitrary text were independently accepted. This can make a failed coverage collection look green.
findings.existing_coverage_credit: The existing coverage tests check ordinary totals and configured exclusions, not fail-closed absence of evidence.
implementation_notes: Require completed LCOV source records and at least one included measurable line.
Test empty, non-LCOV, excluded-only and zero-line reports.
Keep display percentages separate from gate validity.
findings.acceptance_criteria: All four cases reject; a completed included record with real lines still summarizes normally.
findings.risk_or_open_decision: Recheck the actual Bun and Vitest LCOV dialects before merging.
findings.verification: Supplemental evidence is mapped in the patch note; canonical Bun/Vitest/Playwright execution is blocked.

findings.title: Rounded percentages can pass a below-threshold build
findings.observed_gap: The baseline CLI compares a percentage rounded to two decimals. A true 89.999% displays as 90% and passes the 90% gate.
findings.existing_coverage_credit: Existing tests verify summary rendering, not the raw ratio immediately below the cutoff.
implementation_notes: Extract assertCoverageThreshold and compare raw lineHits / lineTotal.
Keep two-decimal presentation unchanged.
Assert just below, exactly at and above 90%.
findings.acceptance_criteria: 89999/100000 fails although the display is 90; 90/100 passes.
findings.verification: Supplemental evidence is mapped in the patch note; canonical Bun/Vitest/Playwright execution is blocked.

findings.title: Malformed LCOV counters can bypass or distort the gate
findings.observed_gap: Baseline NaN hit counts survive parsing and do not fail a less-than comparison; hits greater than totals also produce accepted nonsense.
findings.existing_coverage_credit: Ordinary LF/LH/FNF/FNH summaries already have examples.
implementation_notes: Reject duplicate/missing/negative/fractional/non-numeric/unsafe counts and hits greater than totals.
Require paired optional function counters and unique included source records.
Normalize Windows separators before exclusion and duplicate checks.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Every malformed table entry fails explicitly; valid CRLF/Windows records remain supported.
findings.risk_or_open_decision: This is not a full LCOV grammar or DA/FN-to-summary consistency validator.
findings.verification: Supplemental evidence is mapped in the patch note; canonical Bun/Vitest/Playwright execution is blocked.

findings.title: Cache invalidation reuses an older in-flight loader
findings.observed_gap: A controlled baseline interleaving reproduced a post-invalidation get waiting on, then receiving, the pre-invalidation load. New work must not join an invalidated generation.
findings.existing_coverage_credit: Existing tests cover ordinary invalidation and cache reuse, but not a second get before the old promise resolves.
implementation_notes: Include invalidation generation in the in-flight key.
Use barriers to start old load, invalidate, and resolve the fresh read before releasing the old load.
Repeat for path and global invalidation and clean all promises in finally.
findings.acceptance_criteria: New get returns fresh data before old load is released; old work cannot seed the current cache.
findings.risk_or_open_decision: This does not cancel old loaders or promise linearizable snapshots across filesystem writes.
findings.verification: Supplemental evidence is mapped in the patch note; canonical Bun/Vitest/Playwright execution is blocked.

findings.title: Malformed success envelopes leak untyped failures or falsely typed values
findings.observed_gap: ReadJsonEnvelope previously cast any JSON value; null/array/primitive envelopes and null data did not have a consistently typed client error contract.
findings.existing_coverage_credit: Ordinary API error statuses and well-formed envelopes are already tested.
implementation_notes: Validate top-level parsed unknown before accessing it.
Reject missing/null success data using SpirachaClientError.
Exercise null, arrays, strings, booleans and numbers through a real ephemeral HTTP server.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Malformed success responses reject with SpirachaClientError; ordinary well-formed responses remain compatible.
findings.risk_or_open_decision: Nested DTO schema validation is intentionally not solved here; TG-052.
findings.verification: Supplemental evidence is mapped in the patch note; canonical Bun/Vitest/Playwright execution is blocked.

findings.title: Generated cursors do not round-trip supported long or Unicode IDs
findings.observed_gap: Baseline encode followed by decode rejects an API-valid 2048-character ID; a 1024-CJK ID also exceeds the old 2048 encoded-character limit.
findings.existing_coverage_credit: Existing cursor examples cover ordinary ASCII identifiers and malformed inputs.
implementation_notes: Align decoded ID cap with the API 2048-character contract.
Bound encoded length at 18000 to allow worst-case JSON escaping plus base64 without removing bounds.
Test long ASCII, CJK, surrogate-pair emoji and control-character IDs.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Generated valid boundary cursors decode and paginate; ID length 2049 and encoded length 18001 reject.
findings.risk_or_open_decision: Long request URLs may exceed intermediary defaults; TG-076 requires deployment-boundary review.
findings.verification: Supplemental evidence is mapped in the patch note; canonical Bun/Vitest/Playwright execution is blocked.

implementation_notes: Start Bun.serve on an ephemeral loopback port with a real Codex fixture DB/rollouts.
Inject explicit fixture locations into the production registry, not fake DTOs.
Compare local and HTTP pagination, details and Markdown for all three selectors.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Local and HTTP results match across multiple pages and selectors; server and fixture are always removed.
findings.risk_or_open_decision: Only Codex is covered by the added fixture integration; TG-043 covers the other sources.

findings.title: Coverage denominator omits modules never loaded by tests
findings.observed_gap: The gate only summarizes records emitted by the coverage runner. The static inventory has 100 modules without an obvious direct/adjacent test reference; this is a triage queue, not a measured zero-coverage list.
findings.existing_coverage_credit: Bun coverage and the current aggregate gate exist; PATCH-01 rejects empty reports but cannot discover absent files.
implementation_notes: Generate an eligible production-module manifest excluding generated/type-only/build/fixture files by documented policy.
Compare eligible files to normalized LCOV paths and fail unexplained omissions.
Add tests for unloaded modules, exclusions, Windows paths and duplicate records; avoid importing side-effecting modules just to inflate the denominator.
findings.acceptance_criteria: A deliberately untested eligible module fails the gate even when all imported modules show 100%.
findings.risk_or_open_decision: Policy and runtime instrumentation support need confirmation with the project’s actual Bun version.
findings.verification: Static review only; proposal is not implemented or executed.

findings.title: Aggregate line coverage alone misses critical branches and low-coverage files
findings.observed_gap: Profiles enforce only aggregate line coverage; function percentages are displayed but not gated and branch counts are not parsed.
findings.existing_coverage_credit: The existing 90% line gate remains useful and should not be reduced.
implementation_notes: Agree separate thresholds for mutation/security/parser modules and broader app coverage.
Parse supported branch/function records, test absent branch records and exact threshold boundaries.
Establish an initial honest baseline and ratchet it rather than adding broad exclusions.
findings.acceptance_criteria: An uncovered destructive/error branch or critically under-covered file cannot be masked by easy high-coverage modules.
findings.risk_or_open_decision: Do not invent current percentages; none were measured in this environment.
findings.verification: Static review only; proposal is not implemented or executed.

findings.title: UI exclusions hide route orchestration and critical server bridges
findings.observed_gap: UI coverage excludes all routes and the root gate additionally excludes codex-server/codex-queries. Some orchestration can regress without affecting the gate.
findings.existing_coverage_credit: Many components and server functions are tested indirectly; exclusion does not imply no tests.
implementation_notes: Classify generated wiring versus handwritten decisions.
Extract decision-bearing route helpers where useful, add direct integration tests and selectively include them in coverage.
Keep generated routeTree excluded and never edit it manually.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Import, mutation and deferred-load decision logic has named tests and an accountable coverage policy.
findings.risk_or_open_decision: Avoid chasing framework-generated coverage; prioritize application branches.
findings.verification: Static review only; proposal is not implemented or executed.

findings.title: Real local/HTTP source conformance stops at the new Codex fixture
findings.observed_gap: The new joined integration covers Codex only; the other 12 native sources have different schemas, selectors and raw-export capabilities.
findings.existing_coverage_credit: Each source already has significant adapter/storage fixtures and contract tests.
implementation_notes: Reuse source fixtures behind a shared local-and-HTTP conformance harness.
Parameterize documented capabilities rather than asserting unsupported operations succeed.
Compare ordering, selectors, title/model metadata, raw bytes and domain-not-found behavior on fresh reads.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Every registered source has at least one fixture-backed public-surface contract case without reading the developer’s home.
findings.risk_or_open_decision: Fixtures must stay source-realistic; do not force all sources into Codex semantics.
findings.verification: Static review only; proposal is not implemented or executed.

findings.title: Confirmed browser deletion is not covered end to end
findings.observed_gap: The staged browser tests deliberately cover cancellation and denial, not confirmation with actual storage changes.
findings.existing_coverage_credit: Lower-layer deletion/journal tests are substantial.
implementation_notes: Create a dedicated disposable fixture per destructive test.
Confirm deletion with session-file option on/off and assert UI list/detail behavior after reload.
Reopen DB/files outside the UI and verify targeted removal plus unrelated-record preservation.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Confirmed deletion reaches real storage exactly as requested and UI caches do not resurrect the record.
findings.risk_or_open_decision: Never reuse a developer server; keep this separate from shared read-only browser fixtures.
findings.verification: Static review only; proposal is not implemented or executed.

findings.title: Real SharedWorker and fallback live streaming are untested across browser tabs
findings.observed_gap: Mock clients cannot prove browser worker creation, tab subscriber lifetimes and fallback behavior with the built worker asset.
findings.existing_coverage_credit: Existing live client/transport tests already cover many mocked lifecycle cases.
implementation_notes: Open two tabs on the same fixture thread and observe one shared connection where supported.
Close subscribers and assert monitor release.
Disable/unavailable SharedWorker in a separate context and exercise the documented fallback.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Updates reach both tabs without duplicate application, and all connections close when the last subscriber leaves.
findings.risk_or_open_decision: Worker support differs by browser; capability-specific expectations are needed.

findings.title: A successful non-ZIP response is accepted as an archive
findings.observed_gap: A deployment returning HTML or JSON with HTTP 200 can be wrapped as a ZIP download without a useful SDK error.
findings.existing_coverage_credit: The SDK already handles failing status codes and valid archive responses.
implementation_notes: Normalize and require application/zip after a successful response.
Test HTML/JSON/plain-text success responses and keep typed errors.
Preserve existing missing-conversation semantics.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Wrong MIME responses reject before returning an archive blob.
findings.risk_or_open_decision: Intentional contract tightening: proxies must preserve application/zip. ZIP signature/CRC validation is not added.
findings.verification: Supplemental evidence is mapped in the patch note; canonical Bun/Vitest/Playwright execution is blocked.

findings.title: Loopback security lacks a systematic hostile-origin matrix
findings.observed_gap: Existing examples do not form a contract over opaque origins, userinfo tricks, subdomains, alternate host syntax, ports and scheme mismatches.
findings.existing_coverage_credit: The request-security implementation and basic same-origin/rejection tests already exist; no new authentication model is introduced.
implementation_notes: Add table-driven hostile Origin and Host cases.
Preserve accepted localhost, IPv4 and IPv6 aliases on matching scheme/port.
Include malformed URLs and normalized default ports.
findings.acceptance_criteria: All hostile matrix entries deny and the intended three loopback spellings remain accepted.
findings.risk_or_open_decision: Direct Request construction does not replace actual server/proxy URL normalization testing; see TG-076.
findings.verification: Supplemental evidence is mapped in the patch note; canonical Bun/Vitest/Playwright execution is blocked.

findings.title: Whole-batch validation must precede any destructive side effect
findings.observed_gap: The safety invariant is easy to regress when validating IDs while iterating: a valid prefix could be deleted before an invalid later element is noticed.
findings.existing_coverage_credit: The API has extensive validation examples and deletion tests; the new tests assert zero dependency calls for an invalid entire batch.
implementation_notes: Place an invalid item after a valid ID and spy on the mutation dependency.
Test the 200-item cap before deduplication and stable trimming/deduplication order.
Assert response status/envelope and no mutation on rejection.
findings.acceptance_criteria: No deletion call occurs for an invalid or oversized request; valid deduplicated IDs retain first-seen order.
findings.verification: Supplemental evidence is mapped in the patch note; canonical Bun/Vitest/Playwright execution is blocked.

findings.title: Batch export needs an explicit all-or-nothing missing-item assertion
findings.observed_gap: A batch with existing and missing IDs must not silently deliver a partial ZIP while appearing successful.
findings.existing_coverage_credit: Basic ZIP and missing-single-item paths already exist.
implementation_notes: Assert mixed missing/existing input returns conversation_not_found before ZIP delivery.
Repeat through real HTTP SDK and fixture-backed storage.
Keep this separate from intentionally partial deletion results.
findings.acceptance_criteria: API returns 404 and HTTP client returns null; no partial download is returned.
findings.verification: Supplemental evidence is mapped in the patch note; canonical Bun/Vitest/Playwright execution is blocked.

Verify the actual source route rather than a stubbed response.
Keep Markdown normalization assertions separate.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Every original byte is preserved through API and public HTTP SDK.
findings.verification: Supplemental evidence is mapped in the patch note; canonical Bun/Vitest/Playwright execution is blocked.

findings.title: Browser import preflight boundaries are buried in an excluded route

Preserve existing server exports and route behavior.

implementation_notes: Catch read failures per file and return a typed file error.
Preserve successful payloads and deterministic order while reads complete out of order.
Deduplicate by filename plus message rather than filename alone.

findings.title: Smoke subprocess inherits developer homes, source locations and credentials
findings.observed_gap: The supplied smoke environment spreads process.env and changes only a subset of paths. A real app process can discover unrelated local histories or inherit credentials/preload options.
findings.existing_coverage_credit: The smoke suite already runs an app and package consumers in fixtures; the missing assertion is exhaustive environment isolation.
implementation_notes: Whitelist essential process-launch variables instead of copying all environment keys.
Set HOME/profile/XDG/AppData/temp/cache and every documented source/auth/socket/CLI path under one non-root fixture directory.
Exercise the real helper and update its existing smoke assertion.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Secret/proxy/preload sentinels are absent; all controlled data paths lie beneath the fixture root; source DB override remains explicit.

findings.title: Browser network failure and interrupted download need honest error states
findings.observed_gap: Happy-path browser downloads cannot establish that network/server interruptions avoid false success notifications and stale loading controls.
findings.existing_coverage_credit: Client/unit tests exercise several rejected fetch paths.
implementation_notes: Abort targeted fixture requests or return controlled 500 responses at actual browser boundaries.
Interrupt a download after headers and assert visible error/retry state.

findings.acceptance_criteria: Failed work is not reported as saved/exported and retry succeeds without requiring a full app restart.
findings.risk_or_open_decision: Keep network interception limited to the fault being injected; do not mock the whole app.

findings.observed_gap: Existing crash/replay units do not by themselves prove app startup, route caches and browser state expose reconciled storage consistently.

Read public list/detail endpoints and UI after reconciliation, including a second restart.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Public state matches the documented recovery outcome with no resurrection or unrelated deletion after repeated restarts.
findings.risk_or_open_decision: Production failpoint hooks, if needed, must be test-only and not remotely controllable.

Verify cancellation and consistent error envelopes without relaxing item-count/lens validation.

findings.title: Real SSE append and reconnect need browser-level sequence invariants
findings.observed_gap: Transport mocks do not exercise actual incremental UTF-8 framing, file appends and reconnect after connection loss.
findings.existing_coverage_credit: There are existing SSE helper and parser tests, including shared monitor cleanup.

findings.title: Error logs and retained browser artifacts need a privacy contract
findings.observed_gap: Generic HTTP 500 bodies are tested, but original errors may still be logged; traces/screenshots can contain conversation text and auth-related context.
findings.existing_coverage_credit: PATCH-05 verifies generic client-facing internal errors, and the browser harness uses synthetic data only.
implementation_notes: Define allowed diagnostic fields and redaction rules for paths/tokens/content.
Inject sentinel secrets into controlled errors and capture logs.
Document CI trace access/retention and enforce fixture-only browser environments.
findings.acceptance_criteria: No sentinel secret leaks into user-facing responses or retained logs/artifacts outside the adopted diagnostic policy.
findings.risk_or_open_decision: Logging tradeoffs need an explicit policy; avoid stripping information required for safe recovery.
findings.verification: Static review only; proposal is not implemented or executed.

findings.title: Export filename portability needs Windows reserved-name boundary cases
findings.observed_gap: Path punctuation/Unicode collision tests do not necessarily cover CON/PRN/AUX, trailing dots/spaces and truncation near the filename byte limit.
findings.existing_coverage_credit: Filename sanitization and collision logic already have substantial tests; PATCH-09 adds archive body integrity.
implementation_notes: Locate the actual filename-byte budget and test Windows reserved basenames with/without extensions.
Combine multi-byte truncation with case/NFC collisions and suffix assignment.
Extract generated archives on supported OS fixtures if portable extraction is part of the contract.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Downloaded archive entry names remain distinct and usable on supported platforms without losing content.
findings.risk_or_open_decision: This is a portability gap hypothesis; verify upstream tests and exact limit before changing naming conventions.
findings.verification: Static review only; proposal is not implemented or executed.

findings.title: Cache maxBytes is not demonstrated as a retained-memory bound
findings.observed_gap: File size is a useful admission estimate but parsed objects can expand or retain extra data; naming can imply a stronger memory guarantee than implemented.
findings.existing_coverage_credit: Cache eviction/byte admission and PATCH-06 edge tests exist.
implementation_notes: Document whether maxBytes means source bytes or estimated retained object bytes.
Add expansion-heavy loader fixtures and eviction/admission assertions.
Measure process memory separately if a true memory budget is required; introduce a weight callback only with a clear contract.
findings.acceptance_criteria: The cache budget is accurately named/documented and measured behavior matches that contract.
findings.risk_or_open_decision: Do not treat object-size expansion alone as a bug if the documented budget is source bytes.
findings.verification: Static review only; proposal is not implemented or executed.

findings.title: Static asset realpath containment is not exercised against symlinked build files
findings.observed_gap: Lexical path.resolve containment alone cannot prove containment after a symlink; the practical risk depends on whether build output is trusted and writable.
findings.existing_coverage_credit: Production server tests already cover ordinary assets and path handling.
implementation_notes: Inspect actual static-file dispatch and document the trusted-build assumption.
Serve a fixture dist tree containing an internal symlink to an outside sentinel.
Assert the chosen rejection/containment contract and preserve legitimate asset behavior.
findings.acceptance_criteria: No unreviewed path follows a symlink outside the allowed static root under the adopted policy.
findings.risk_or_open_decision: This is a medium-confidence hardening opportunity, not a demonstrated production data leak.
findings.verification: Static review only; proposal is not implemented or executed.

findings.title: SDK timeout and cancellation behavior has no explicit public contract
findings.observed_gap: Long local/HTTP exports can outlive a caller’s intent; the current API does not expose an obvious unified cancellation/timeout option.
findings.existing_coverage_credit: Ordinary network failure/status handling is tested.
implementation_notes: Decide whether caller-provided AbortSignal belongs on client defaults, operation options or both.
Add delayed-response/stream tests with abort before connect and during body transfer.
Verify typed abort errors and cleanup without converting cancellation into not-found.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Documented cancellation stops work where supported and cannot return a misleading successful or null result.
findings.risk_or_open_decision: This is a design-dependent improvement, not a reproduced API bug.
findings.verification: Static review only; proposal is not implemented or executed.

blockers.title: Canonical toolchain unavailable
blockers.detail: Bun, rtk, installed app dependencies, Biome and Playwright are unavailable; container DNS prevents dependency download. Seven required Bun commands were attempted and exited 127. This is not an application test failure.

blockers.title: Original CLI input missing from supplied archive
blockers.detail: bin/spiracha.ts is named by package.json/build/package scripts but absent from the input ZIP. The existing package-manifest test already checks this. Restore the actual upstream file; do not fabricate a replacement or resurrect removed legacy surfaces.

blockers.title: Repository metadata provenance incomplete
blockers.detail: Hidden CI/ignore metadata may have been omitted by archive creation. No claim is made about the current upstream hosted CI or .gitignore.
